findings.finding: Qualified local POC001 and POC002 accept matching fabricated sample checksum/approval/encode input digest without any actual sample byte reference.
findings.minimalOwnedFix: Add a qualified inputSampleArtifact mapping in owned program.schema.yaml $defs/environmentCaptured (sampleId, selected-slot ref, actual byteCount and SHA), exactly bind each approved sample immutableId/checksum and encode input to its actual nonempty binary artifact using existing bounded inspect_artifact. No external object store/API/schema file required; legacy schemas/templates remain unchanged.
findings.referenceBoundary: Exact selected profile slot; actual source/ignored-reference checks already collect environment refs. Preserve approval identity/time and structured-vs-binary artifact disjointness.
findings.directRegressions: Actual small input bytes baseline; same fabricated checksum in both records rejected; actual input-byte mutation rejected even when original claimed approval/hash remain equal.

findings.finding: Qualified local POC004 baseline profile config has no independent approvedAt/reviewer; adding approvedAt after finishedAt and before validation remains accepted. Existing resourceConfiguration approval does not cover the profile-level floor/config choices.
findings.minimalOwnedFix: Use a qualified profileConfiguration $def in existing owned program.schema.yaml with schemaVersion2, exact task/poc/profile/testedSource/resources/measurements, approved decision, current independent Task reviewer and UTC approvedAt. Enforce approvedAt <= captured executionWindow.startedAt and <= validation now; preserve current capacity/source-scope/domain fields and existing resource approvals, no new approval roles or global workflow.
findings.directRegressions: Missing approval timestamp/identity, implementer-as-reviewer, wrong exact profile/task, and post-start approval rejected; pre-start independent valid configuration accepted; legacy canonical plan unchanged.

findings.finding: Production qualified POC001 PASS accepts multi_day_stability_duration0 with multi_day_stabilitytrue.
findings.minimalOwnedFix: PASS-specific production qualified POC001 duration must be positive in existing hours unit alongside existing boolean gate. Retain frozen plan/threshold-source and all production obligations; do not invent a universal new48/72hour requirement. Failure/inconclusive zero remains factual, localVM route unaffected.
findings.directRegressions: Production PASS0 rejected/positive baseline accepted; production FAIL0 representable; existing localVM regression retained.

findings.finding: Local POC005 hierarchy, POC006 fault matrix, POC007 TLS path and POC002 segment/scheduler configurations accept scalarTrue with consistently matching numeric-domain environment approval. recorded(True) is only presence, not structured capture.
findings.minimalOwnedFix: Add field-specific qualified schemas in existing owned program.schema.yaml $defs, selected by exact POC/profile; validate captured objects or exact selected-slot versioned refs that are dereferenced and validated, with profileConfiguration approval covering the same capture. Keep original source/protocol/POC identities, frozen plans and legacy record schemas.

minimumShapesWithoutNewFramework.synthetic_hierarchy_manifest: Versioned identified hierarchy record/ref with concrete file/directory layout or reproducible generator parameters and positive populations; scalar/placeholder/empty capture rejected.
minimumShapesWithoutNewFramework.injected_failure_matrix: Nonempty typed case array with named injected fault/status or disconnect, exercised case identity and corresponding raw observation refs, preserving existing429/5xx/network/auth obligations.
minimumShapesWithoutNewFramework.local_tls_path_configuration: Concrete isolated TLS/proxy/OpenList route and configuration/certificate identity or ref, matching selected local sandbox boundary; secrets remain forbidden.
minimumShapesWithoutNewFramework.segment_profile: Concrete codec/container and positive finite segment duration plus captured relevant settings; scalar rejected.
minimumShapesWithoutNewFramework.scheduler_configuration: Concrete captured policy/settings used by run, preserving declared playback/prewarm/background priorities and scoped limits; scalar rejected.

findings.directRegressions: Each exact listed field scalarTrue/empty/wrong-profile ref rejected; minimally concrete valid capture accepted; existing local routes and all production original fields remain retained.
